name: mond-atlas-pressure-support-001
scope: Synthetic radial mechanics only; steady axisymmetric inviscid gas with isotropic thermal plus turbulent pressure, zero radial and vertical mean flow. No cube extension and no observed source or velocity access.

equations.volume: vphi^2 = R * [partial_R Phi + partial_R P / rho] at a specified height
equations.surface: vphi^2 = R * [g_bar + partial_R Pi / Sigma], Pi=int P dz=Sigma*c_eff^2, g_bar=int rho*partial_R Phi dz/Sigma; vphi is height-independent in the admitted closure
equations.support: D = -R * partial_R Pi / Sigma; vphi^2 = vc^2-D; vc^2=R*g_bar
equations.stress: c_eff^2 = c_thermal^2 + sigma_turbulent_1d^2; turbulent stress must be isotropic
equations.line: sigma_line^2 = c_thermal^2*(mean_particle_mass/tracer_particle_mass) + sigma_turbulent_1d^2 + sigma_instrument^2 + sigma_unresolved^2; the latter two terms are not pressure
equations.continuity: R*Sigma*u_R = constant; regular center and no sink imply u_R=0. Nonzero radial or vertical mean flow is rejected, not fitted.

references.authors: Wang, Klessen, Dullemond, van den Bosch and Fuchs
references.title: Equilibrium Initialization and Stability of Three-Dimensional Gas Disks
references.binding: Equations (1), (2), (6), (9) and Appendix A: steady radial and vertical Euler equations, isothermal scalar pressure, vertical equilibrium and height-independent barotropic rotation. No Poisson/self-gravity solver is implemented.

references.title: LITTLE THINGS in 3D: robust determination of the circular velocity of dwarf irregular galaxies
references.binding: Section 4.3, equations (6)-(7): isotropic gas Euler/Jeans asymmetric-drift sign and density-pressure logarithmic gradient. Only equations are used, no galaxy measurements or fitted profiles.

definitions: pressureless equality to supplied circular force
declining, constant and increasing pressure signs
Gaussian density and dispersion-gradient analytic support
independent finite differences of scalar potential and pressure
second-order pressure derivative resolution including outer boundary
regular center zero speed and gradient; cusp at center rejected
negative rotation squared retained and speed request rejected
surface/volume column types cannot be interchanged
flaring 3D manufactured Euler solution with vertical quadrature and vertical hydrostatic balance
flaring surface force must be density-weighted, not midplane
thermal tracer conversion and isotropic turbulent stress guard
same line width can imply different supporting stress
nonzero radial and vertical mean flow rejected; constant radial flow violates continuity
known-pressure noiseless recovery in independent harmonic and cored-log manufactured curves
harmonic pressure-blind force bias and exact pressure-force degeneracy

profiles: Sigma=Sigma0*exp(-R^2/(2*L_Sigma^2)); c_eff^2=c0^2*exp(-R^2/(2*L_c^2)), with null L_c meaning constant. Profiles continue smoothly beyond the sample window. Sigma0=1.
boundary: Regular center when included. Rmax is a sampling boundary, not a vacuum truncation. Outer pressure is supplied by continuation of the analytic profile; no free-edge equilibrium is claimed.

study.observable: major-axis LOS mean speeds sin(i)*vphi; fixed geometry; synthetic radial samples without beam, mask or cube
study.noise: independent Gaussian speed errors, known constant sigma; each fresh packet independent of training packet
study.fit: One potential amplitude, fixed shape and pressure profile. Minimize speed Gaussian chi-square with scipy.optimize.minimize_scalar bounded; enforce nonnegative vphi^2 at all sampled radii. No squared-speed Gaussian approximation.
study.report: Retain every fit/failure, signed invalid vphi^2, amplitude relative bias, train and heldout q/N, fresh-noise q/N on heldout radii, and noiseless signal RMSE. These are small conditional diagnostics, not significance or gravity-law evidence.

unresolved: observational pressure tensor and thermal/turbulent decomposition
vertical structure and force averaging in observed systems
gas self-gravity or coupled Poisson solution
boundary mass/pressure matching for real gas disks
